ads.title: Struggling to switch off at night?
ads.body: India’s first Triple Magnesium Complex is formulated with 3 potent forms of Magnesium to calm your nervous system, relax your muscles and help you fall (and stay) asleep.

What you need to know about Magnesium Most people rely on blood tests but magnesium deficiencies can’t be tested for. Only ~1% is in your blood. The rest is in your muscles, bones, organs. Add poor diet + stress + training → easy to be low. Look for forms ending in “-ate” (better absorption): Glycinate (sleep), Threonate (brain), Citrate (digestion) That’s why I use @wellbeing.nutrition Triple Strength Magnesium — blend of all 3, ~220mg elemental per serving. Meeting 50% of your RDA with 2 capsules.
